tool_schemas.name: pokemon-card-search
tool_schemas.description: Searches the normalized Pokémon TCG card catalog using a required free-text query plus optional structured filters and returns a page of matching cards sorted by the requested order; results are paged with an opaque cursor you pass back to retrieve the next page, and each request is recorded for auditing and rate-limiting. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is empty/invalid, if any filter keys/values are not supported, or if limit/cursor/sort are malformed or out of range. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if your credentials are missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if your token is not allowed to search this catalog, and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed your allowed request quota.

query.description: Free-text search query for matching cards (e.g., card name or keywords).

filters.description: Structured search filters to narrow results (e.g., set_code, set_name, supertype, rarity, artist, status).

limit.description: Maximum number of cards to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: pokemon-card-price
tool_schemas.description: Returns the best available market-price snapshot for a single card identified by card_id or lookup_key, optionally selecting by source_preference, currency, and/or a point-in-time at; the response includes the chosen snapshot and its effective timestamp/source, and the lookup is recorded for auditing and rate-limiting. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither card_id nor lookup_key is provided, if card_id fails the required format, or if source_preference/currency/at are invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND when the card cannot be resolved from the provided identifier or when no price snapshot exists that matches the requested constraints, plus UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for access control failures and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed your allowed request quota.

card_id.description: Internal card id (ULID) to fetch pricing for.

lookup_key.description: Alternate lookup key (e.g., external id / set+number string) to identify the card when card_id is not provided.

source_preference.description: Preferred marketplace/source to use when multiple price snapshots exist.

currency.description: ISO-like currency code to prefer when selecting a price snapshot (e.g., USD, EUR).

at.description: Optional point-in-time for price selection; if omitted, returns the most recent current snapshot.

tool_schemas.name: pokemon-card-get
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single Pokémon TCG card by internal card_id and returns its normalized catalog record. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the card does not exist or is blocked.

tool_schemas.name: pokemon-price-snapshot-list
tool_schemas.description: Lists price snapshots for a given card_id, optionally filtered by source/currency/status and ordered by snapshot_at. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the card does not exist; returns an empty page if no snapshots match.

card_id.description: Internal card id (ULID) whose price history to list.

currency.description: Filter snapshots by currency (e.g., USD, EUR).

limit.description: Maximum number of snapshots to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: pokemon-price-snapshot-create
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new price snapshot for a card from a given source/currency and marks any previous current snapshot for the same (card_id, source) as superseded in the same transaction. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid fields, NOT_FOUND if card_id does not exist, and CONFLICT if a snapshot would violate integrity rules.

card_id.description: Internal card id (ULID) the snapshot is for.

currency.description: Currency code for all prices in this snapshot (e.g., USD, EUR).

market_price.description: Market/median price for the card at snapshot_at.

low_price.description: Low price observed for the card at snapshot_at.

high_price.description: High price observed for the card at snapshot_at.

direct_low_price.description: Direct/verified low price observed at snapshot_at when available.

snapshot_at.description: Timestamp representing when the market observation was taken.

status.description: Lifecycle status for the new snapshot; use invalid to record unusable data.

tool_schemas.name: pokemon-api-client-create
tool_schemas.description: Creates an API client used for authenticating and rate-limiting requests, returning the client record and a one-time plaintext api_key. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid limits/fields.

display_name.description: Human-friendly name for this API client.

requests_per_minute_limit.description: Sliding-window per-minute request limit for this client.

requests_per_day_limit.description: UTC-day request limit for this client.

tool_schemas.name: pokemon-api-client-update
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing API client’s mutable fields and lifecycle status, including suspending/reactivating or deleting a client. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the client does not exist and VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid transitions or fields.

status.description: New lifecycle status; must follow allowed transitions.

tool_schemas.name: pokemon-whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated API client identity for the presented API key, including status, scopes, and current rate-limit/quota usage. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid and FORBIDDEN if the client is deleted.

api_key.description: API key presented by the caller; if omitted, the service uses the standard Authorization header when available.

metadata.name: Pokemon TCG Card Search
metadata.description: This backend supports a Pokemon TCG card search service and a card market-price lookup feature. It stores a normalized catalog of cards and their printings plus periodic price snapshots from external marketplaces, and records each API lookup for auditing and rate-limiting. Repository: https://github
